hook: Mustafa Suleyman was born in London in 1984 and studied at the University of Oxford. In 2010 he co-founded DeepMind, an artificial intelligence research lab that Google acquired in 2014, where he went on to lead applied AI and policy work. After leaving Google in 2019 and a period as a venture partner at Greylock, he co-founded Inflection AI in March 2022 with Reid Hoffman and Karen Simonyan, building the Pi personal assistant and the Inflection-2.5 model. In 2023 he published The Coming Wave, a book arguing that AI and synthetic biology pose a containment problem for governments and societies. In March 2024 he joined Microsoft as CEO of Microsoft AI, leading the Copilot consumer AI effort, and he has continued to write and speak about what he calls building humanist superintelligence.

standing.standing: Mustafa Suleyman is CEO of Microsoft AI, where he leads the Copilot consumer AI effort, and he is an executive of Microsoft, a public company founded in 1975 in Redmond, WA, USA. He co-founded DeepMind in 2010, and Google acquired it in 2014, after which he led applied AI and policy work there. He left Google in 2019 and spent a period as a venture partner at Greylock. In March 2022 he co-founded Inflection AI with Reid Hoffman and Karen Simonyan, building the Pi personal assistant and the Inflection-2.5 model. He published The Coming Wave in 2023 and is a Senior Fellow at Harvard Kennedy School's Belfer Center for Science and International Affairs.
